research_summary: Partial: entropy on the basin is $\log d$; whether the boundary carries full entropy is not fully settled. Literature status: - **Background.** A proper holomorphic endomorphism of a simply connected basin of degree $d$ has topological entropy $\log d$ on the basin; the question is whether the boundary $\partial U$ carries the full entropy $\log d$. This is a delicate radial-limit/entropy question studied by Przytycki and by others (e.g., "entropy of the boundary of Julia-like sets"). Not verified as fully resolved.
